name: Calling
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly calls individuals for specific purposes, as seen when He asks, 'Whom shall I send?' and Isaiah responds, 'Here am I; send me' (Isaiah 6:8). From before birth, God knows and sanctifies His servants, ordaining them for His mission (Jeremiah 1:5). Believers are chosen by Christ to bear lasting fruit and serve in His name (John 15:16), and the Holy Spirit directs the church to set apart workers for His work (Acts 13:2). This calling involves a divine purpose and a response of faithful obedience, emphasizing God's initiative and the believer's willing participation.
